usage: eight particle masks rendered as Phaser 3 battle effects
openSourceContent.curation: Particle masks were cropped and recolored at runtime. Sound effects were selected for semantic fit, mastered, peak-limited, and play-tested in battle.

humanOversight: Curated prompts, seeds, model versions, source masters, and hashes are retained in assets/manifest.json and workflows/api.
Generated hero and enemy cutouts were reviewed and corrected for silhouettes, alpha edges, weapons, hands, props, and readable scale.
All music was edited, crossfaded, loudness-mastered, loop-tested, and encoded before integration.
Human-authored game code, narrative, interface layout, rules, balancing, and final composition determine the shipped experience.
No player input, save data, telemetry, or personal data is sent to a generative model or developer-operated server at runtime.

externalReview.requiredAction: The release owner must confirm commercial terms for every model, LoRA, custom node, and training-data dependency before submitting the Steam generative-AI disclosure.
